which_half_read: data half (include/monsters.h, objects.h, artilist.h, hack.h, trap.h, dat/*.lua names and fill files, win/share tile headers as per AU036) and engine half for the cited mechanisms (include/monst.h macros, src/dungeon.c level_difficulty, src/allmain.c spawn roll, src/artifact.c glow and light code, src/role.c headers, src/u_init.c first skill table, include/skills.h). creature_families: Material-ladder golem: 11 golems, straw (level 3) to iron (level 18), no corpse (include/monsters.h lines 2509, 2530, 2586)
Colour-coded dragon family: 11 baby (level 12), 11 adult (level 15), Chromatic Dragon (16), Ixoth (15) (lines 1341, 1432)
Lich ladder: four rungs at levels 11, 14, 17, 25 (lines 1864, 1880, 1889)
Vortex set: six vortex types, fog (3) to fire (8) (line 1101)
Demon princes at levels 50 to 106, out of the normal band (line 3055)
Vampire tiers: vampire (10), vampire mage (20), Vlad the Impaler (28) (line 2313)

top_creatures.label: Material-ladder golem
top_creatures.why: each golem is a named material, so the ladder teaches itself; gold sits mid-ladder
top_creatures.keep: a material name per rung; no corpse
top_creatures.change: zone materials for our rungs; gold golem gets a gilt shimmer, not a flat yellow

top_creatures.label: Colour-coded dragon
top_creatures.why: colour names the resistance, so the threat reads by colour
top_creatures.keep: colour equals resistance; baby and adult split by level
top_creatures.change: our six elements with a head crest

top_creatures.label: Lich ladder
top_creatures.why: four rungs with clear level jumps
top_creatures.change: a different crown silhouette per rung

top_creatures.label: Vortex set
top_creatures.why: six vortex types escalate from mist to a fire-topped rung
top_creatures.change: a column with a spiral, not a cloud

top_creatures.label: Mimic ladder
top_creatures.why: a disguise that scales by size
top_creatures.keep: disguise as an item, scaled by size
top_creatures.change: disguise as a loot shrine, not a chest

top_creatures.label: Angel ladder
top_creatures.why: a lawful minion line with a staged jump to a large winged form

top_creatures.label: Out-of-band demon princes
top_creatures.why: a boss tier that exists only beyond the normal level band
top_creatures.keep: out-of-band boss behind a zone key
top_creatures.change: the key is a zone item, not a level number

top_creatures.label: Three-rung vampire ladder
top_creatures.why: three rungs with a named top
top_creatures.change: the top rung is a new silhouette

originals.keep: colour equals resistance; baby and adult split
originals.change: our six elements with a head crest

originals.name: Four-Rung Lich
originals.idea: undead ladder of four rungs with clear level jumps

originals.name: Escalating Vortex Column
originals.idea: six vortex types from mist to fire with a fire-topped rung

originals.name: Shrine Mimic Ladder

originals.name: Warn Glow Weapon
